start.description: Start backend and frontend dev servers
start.command: Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList "-NoExit -Command cd $(pwd)\backend; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList "-NoExit -Command cd $(pwd)\frontend; npm run dev"

transformer.description: Agent responsible for executing the agentic transformation plan
transformer.instructions: Follow AGENTIC_TRANSFORMATION_PLAN.md for the strategic roadmap. Follow SPRINT1_QUICKSTART.md for Sprint 1 implementation details. Document all progress in PROGRESS.md.
